messages.subject: [R list package] R package "list" question
messages.body_plain:
Hi Meredith,

   Sorry for the poor documentation.  I'm ccing my coauthor who should 
be able to correct me if I'm wrong on this and update the documentation 
accordingly, but something like the following (an example of 3 control 
items) should work:

ictreg(cbind(control.y1, control.y2, control.y3, treat.y) ~ x1 + x2, 
data = data)

Kosuke

-- 
Department of Politics
Princeton University
http://imai.princeton.edu


On 8/12/11 2:52 PM, Meredith A. Kleykamp wrote:
> Hi Kosuke-
>
> This is Meredith Kleykamp?if you remember me from KU (now at UMD). I
> have a hopefully quick question for you about your list package in R. I
> have some data collected through the TESS program that uses the item
> count technique to identify whether people respond to questions about
> military veterans in socially desirable ways. We designed the survey to
> use the usual item count approach and using Dan Corstange?s method of
> asking about individual items (for comparison of estimates using the two
> methods). I saw you mentioned that your list package could analyze the
> ?Corstange? method of data collection but wasn?t quite clear on how to
> call that in the package, nor how to have the data organized in R for
> analysis with that method.
>
> DO you have any sample code that runs the Corstange kind of analysis,
> and maybe a snippet of how the data would be structured?
>
> Thanks for any assistance. Hope you are well!
>
> Best,
>
> Meredith
